summary: International Media Acquisition Corp., a SPAC, filed an 8-K reporting a $2,000 trust deposit to extend its deadline to complete an initial business combination by one month, from September 2, 2026 to October 2, 2026. This is the 21st of 24 permitted extensions under its trust agreement. No transaction, price, premium, or recommendation is involved. The filing is a routine SPAC extension notice and does not constitute a special-situation event, so the correct classification is None. What to watch: upcoming deadlines and any potential business combination announcement before October 2026.
